newsitem.title: USA: TWA matches Continental fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: TWA matches Continental fare cuts.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Thursday it will match air fare cuts announced by Continental Airlines Inc, and offer discounts of up to 50 percent off 21 day advance purchase fares for domestic flights including Honolulu and Toronto.
Tickets for the non-refundable sale fares must be bought within three days of making a reservation. Travel requires a Saturday night stay, and other restrictions apply, TWA said.
Tickets must be purchased no later than February 14 and all travel must be completed by September 30, it said in a statement.
